title: The Sap Map
lines: A map is at the mat.
Sam is sap. Pam is sap.
The map is at Sam. Pat the sap!

questions.ask: What is on the mat with Sam and Pam?
questions.listenFor: A map. It is said in the third line. If your child is not sure, point at that line and let them read it again rather than telling them.
Sap, the sticky juice that comes out of a tree. You are listening for the word sap, not a long answer. If they say sticky, that counts.

questions.ask: Do you think the map will come off Sam? Tell me why you think that.
questions.listenFor: There is no wrong answer. You are listening for a reason, like sap is sticky or they kept patting it. The reason matters more than the answer.
